items.title: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading

sentences.en: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading.
sentences.zh: 中美贸易战似乎已经平息，但平静的感觉具有误导性。

sentences.en: A truce has cooled the trade conflict, but neither country has done anything to limit the outbreak of new hostilities Donald Trump ’s trade wars have largely fallen off the headlines.
sentences.zh: 休战让贸易冲突降温，但两国都没有采取任何措施来限制新的敌对行动的爆发，唐纳德·特朗普的贸易战在很大程度上已经从头条新闻中消失。

sentences.en: Fears of new tariffs flare up from time to time when the US president goes off the rails – for instance, threatening to end US trade with countries with which it has a deficit unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates.
sentences.zh: 当美国总统偏离轨道时，对新关税的担忧不时爆发–例如，除非美联储降低利率，否则威胁要结束美国与赤字国家的贸易。

sentences.en: But the sense that the world’s two largest economies are plowing ahead into an overt economic conflagration has taken a back seat to other, more salient fears, about Trump ending American democracy, AI killing us all and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 但是，世界上最大的两个经济体正在陷入一场公开的经济大战的感觉已经让位于其他更突出的担忧，即特朗普结束美国民主，人工智能杀死我们所有人等等。

sentences.en: The sense of calm is misleading.
sentences.zh: 平静的感觉具有误导性。

sentences.en: Under the radar, the world is marching toward an economic war of potentially epic proportions, one that, history suggests, could well spill over into the real thing.
sentences.zh: 在雷达下，世界正在走向一场潜在史诗般规模的经济战争，历史表明，这场战争很可能蔓延到现实世界。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Western Sahara: UN ‘stands ready’ to keep supporting peace efforts as MINURSO mission ends

sentences.en: Western Sahara: UN ‘stands ready’ to keep supporting peace efforts as MINURSO mission ends.
sentences.zh: 西撒哈拉：联合国随时准备在西撒特派团任务结束时继续支持和平努力。

sentences.en: The UN remains committed to supporting a just, lasting and mutually acceptable political solution in Western Sahara that provides for the self-determination of its people, Secretary-General António Guterres said on Sunday, as the UN peacekeeping mission there began to wind down.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（ António Guterres ）周日表示，随着联合国在西撒哈拉的维和任务开始结束，联合国仍然致力于支持西撒哈拉的公正、持久和彼此接受的政治解决方案，该方案为其人民的自决提供了条件。

items.title: COP17: Nations chart ‘Yerevan Pathway’ to speed up action for nature

sentences.en: COP17: Nations chart ‘Yerevan Pathway’ to speed up action for nature.
sentences.zh: COP17 ：国家图表“埃里温途径” ，以加快对自然的行动。

sentences.en: At the halfway mark to 2030, countries meeting in Armenia have agreed a roadmap to accelerate action for nature, after a global review found the world off track to meet its biodiversity targets.
sentences.zh: 在全球审查发现世界偏离实现其生物多样性目标的轨道后，在亚美尼亚举行会议的国家在2030年中期商定了加快自然行动的路线图。

items.title: Breaking the silence in Mexico’s barracks

sentences.en: Breaking the silence in Mexico’s barracks.
sentences.zh: 打破墨西哥军营的沉默。

sentences.en: In Mexico’s armed forces, an order from a superior is meant to be obeyed without question.
sentences.zh: 在墨西哥的武装部队中，上级的命令是毫无疑问地服从的。

sentences.en: For many women in uniform, investigative journalist Zorayda Gallegos found, that can include an order to step into an officer’s bedroom.
sentences.zh: 调查记者佐雷达·加列戈斯（ Zorayda Gallegos ）发现，对于许多穿制服的女性来说，这可能包括命令她们进入警官的卧室。

items.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent

sentences.en: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent.
sentences.zh: 随着德国生活费用抗议活动转向暴力，商店遭到抢劫。

sentences.en: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.
sentences.zh: 包括柏林、汉堡和法兰克福在内的德国各城市的抗议活动发生在同一天，数十万人也在法国举行了抗议活动。

items.title: Binance resumes customer withdrawals after record $6.3bn hack

sentences.en: Binance resumes customer withdrawals after record $6.3bn hack.
sentences.zh: 币安在创纪录的63亿美元黑客攻击后恢复客户提款。

sentences.en: Cryptocurrency exchange says 90% of losses covered as FBI blames North Korean state-sponsored group TraderTraitor The cryptocurrency exchange Binance has started to allow its customers to withdraw their funds from the platform, as it recovers from a record $6.3bn (£4.7bn) hack.
sentences.zh: 加密货币交易所表示，联邦调查局将90%的损失归咎于朝鲜国家支持的团体TraderTraitor加密货币交易所币安已开始允许其客户从该平台提取资金，因为它从创纪录的63亿美元（ 47亿英镑）黑客攻击中恢复过来。

sentences.en: The exchange was hit by the theft on Thursday, which has since been described as the biggest heist in history, with experts identifying North Korea as the likely culprit.
sentences.zh: 该交易所周四遭到盗窃，此后被描述为历史上最大的抢劫案，专家确定朝鲜可能是罪魁祸首。

items.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book

sentences.en: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book.

items.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials

sentences.zh: 该命令是在选举官员收到要求他们搁置可能的非公民选民的选票的信件之后发布的。
